query: Goods-to-person versus person-to-goods order picking in manufacturing and warehousing, with vertical lift modules in particular: travel-time and throughput models for VLMs (for example Meller and Klote 2004; Dukic, Opetuk and Lerher 2015; Rosi et al. 2016; Sgarbossa, Calzavara and Persona 2019; Calzavara et al.), dual-command cycle times as a function of height, vertical speed and acceleration, typical trays per hour for one access opening, dual-tray (two-level) openings, the conditions under which a VLM is economical (number of stock-keeping units, pick frequency, floor cost) and when it is not, and comparisons with shelving, horizontal carousels, mini-load AS/RS, shuttle systems and autonomous mobile robots.
